title: Launch orchestration sprint: activation heatmap and release briefing for Private/VPC
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Coordinate a focused sprint to produce an actionable activation heatmap, finalized release briefing, and stakeholder-ready enablement assets for the upcoming Private/VPC on‑prem launch focusing on RBAC, audit logs, and KMS. This ticket centralizes cross-team deliverables (Docs, Console, Eng runbooks, Legal/compliance signoff) and defines a communication cadence for customers and internal GTM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Activation heatmap created with customer cohort mapping, readiness gates, and roll dates for first three waves
Release briefing doc completed and approved by Product, Security, and Legal
Release notes finalized, staged in the product website drafts, and linked to SDK changelog
Enablement kit (one‑pager, webinar script, ops runbook) produced and scheduled for internal training
All required compliance artifacts (KMS integration checklist, audit log retention matrix, RBAC policy templates) signed off
Telemetry/usage events and SLO checks instrumented with dashboards pre-populated for first 14 days
tasks: Run a 2-hour kickoff with ENG, SRE, Docs, Sales Engineering, Legal on 2026-02-16
Draft activation heatmap: list initial 25 customers, assign cohorts (pilot / early / general), and define success criteria
Compile RBAC policy templates for common IAM configurations (AWS, GCP, Azure) and pass to Security for review
Create audit-log retention guidance and sample queries for customers and Console display text
Finalize KMS onboarding checklist including KMS key rotation and envelope encryption notes
Produce release briefing deck and circulate by 2026-02-22 for review
Author release notes draft and publish internal preview link to the Docs QA channel
Coordinate two internal enablement sessions (PM deep dive + SRE operations) during release week
Open follow-up Linear tickets for any post-launch polish found during pilot
Confirm telemetry event names and dashboard templates with Observability team; add dashboard links to briefing
stakeholders: Daniel Park (SRE) - rollout gating and telemetry
Vanessa Ruiz (Docs) - release notes and customer guides
rollout_steps: Wave 0: internal beta + canary customers (5) — validate RBAC/KMS flows
Wave 1: Early access (20) — provide guided onboarding and 72h ops support
Wave 2: Broader cohort (100) — open self-serve docs, monitor dashboards closely
Wave 3: General availability — public release notes + marketing comms
Fallback: Auto-failover to hosted-compatible model variant if KV/cache or latency breaches SLO
release_notes_outline: Summary: what changed (RBAC, audit logs, KMS enablement) and why it matters
Installation/Onboarding: key steps for Private/VPC customers
RBAC: default roles, recommended mappings, troubleshooting tips
Audit Logs: fields included, retention options, sample queries
KMS: supported providers, key lifecycle, recommended rotation cadence
communication_plan: Internal: Weekly release standups M/W/F during cycle; final readiness email 48h before wave 0
Sales: Pre-brief deck + FAQ shared 5 business days before early access; hub page for demo assets
Customers: Targeted email to pilot cohort with onboarding slots; public release notes on GA
Docs: Publish KB and migration guide on release date; staged preview link available to SEs
Support: Add canned responses and runbook entries to Zendesk and internal Playbooks
compliance_checklist: KMS: Verify integration tests for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault pass in private environment
Audit logs: Confirm retention settings and encryption-at-rest for stored logs
RBAC: Legal review of role names and customer-data access boundaries
Contracts: Ensure enterprise contract templates include required security clauses for on-prem deployments
PenTest sign-off: Schedule rapid pentest window or confirm no new network exposure introduced
risks: Customer onboarding friction if KMS docs are incomplete — mitigated by sample scripts and SE runbooks
Telemetry gaps causing blindspots in first 48h — mitigate by duplicating critical SLO events and on-call watch
Late security signoff could delay GA — escalate to CISO and PM for prioritization
Cross-cloud RBAC nuances may require per-customer tweaks — include SE time allocation in staffing plan
